name: qwen-code
label: Qwen Code
description: Alibaba's open-source terminal coding agent for Qwen models, driven headless

check_ready.not_ready_message: Not configured — set an API key and a model (press e). Qwen Code has no CLI sign-in; a Model Studio (DashScope) key works with the prefilled base URL.

env_config.name: LLM_API_KEY
env_config.description: API key for an OpenAI-compatible endpoint — a Model Studio (DashScope) key, or a Bailian Coding Plan key together with its own base URL.

env_config.name: LLM_BASE_URL
env_config.description: OpenAI-compatible base URL, prefilled with Model Studio China. International: https://dashscope-intl.aliyuncs.com/compatible-mode/v1 — Coding Plan: https://coding.dashscope.aliyuncs.com/v1 (international: https://coding-intl.dashscope.aliyuncs.com/v1)

env_config.name: LLM_MODEL
env_config.description: Model id, e.g. qwen3.8-flash. Pick one the base URL serves — Coding Plan offers a shorter list than Model Studio.

tagline: Qwen's terminal coding agent, on your Model Studio or Coding Plan key.
